title: ItsBizKit Sits Down With Hot New Hip Hop And Discusses Being Authentic
htmlContent: ItsBizkit recently sat down with Hot New Hip Hop to discuss how he started his platform posting Chinx and French Montana's content when other platforms would not.  He also talks about the viral video of Funk Flex saying "F*ck That Canadian N***a" aimed at Drizzy. Bizkit also talks about working with DJ Whoo Kid and Green Lantern on exclusive mixtapes and make good money during that era.   Bizkit goes into detail about how memes and viral campaigns have become like releasing a hit record.  People are becoming household names off of these strategic campaigns with Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Snapchat. ItsBizKit full interview with Hot New Hip Hop above and make sure leave your comments below.
